about: Case corpus of the content validator for the synthetic world "korpus". Expectations are computed by hand from the weight, tier and stage rules of the kernel draft, independent of the validator. Entwicklung cases give the issue codes and the hand-computed budget (effect, price, net), Bestimmung cases the issue codes and the total difficulty, proposal cases the envelope issues and the verdict of each item. A case of kind "world" is judged as shipped world content, "candidate" as an agent candidate of the people schar (open tier, stack cap and grounding apply). Item verdicts of a proposal whose envelope has issues are rejected with empty codes, the reason sits in expect.issues. Drafts, states and tasks carry the invariants the schemas cannot express; a state case is a base fixture of tests/fixtures/engine plus set and move operations on JSON pointers, a task case the context task plus such operations.
